title: spar-exocortex proposal template envelope
description: Final proposal document written to Proposal/SPAR-{problem-slug}.md. Schema validates the structured fields a proposal must contain; markdown rendering is template-driven from the matching proposal-template.json.

slug.description: Slug used in the file path: Proposal/SPAR-{slug}.md

baseline.description: Conforms to baseline-schema.json. Schema cross-reference enforced by orchestration validator, not flattened here.

finalDecision.description: Winner across all rounds. Derived from the final round's judge.decision (endorse-baseline → baseline-wins; endorse-challenger → challenger-wins). demand-round-two is never the final decision.

operationalGraftSummary.description: Optional. Summary of the operational-graft answer if ops-critical.
